subject: Energy
title: Energy vs. Force
description: A micro-lesson that makes Energy vs. Force usable.

hook.text: People often confuse energy with force—but they're fundamentally different concepts.

buildup.text: A force is a push or pull (measured in newtons). Energy is the ability to do work (measured in joules).

discovery.text: Work bridges the two: when a force moves an object, energy transfers. Work = force × distance.

twist.text: You can push a wall all day—but if it doesn't move, you've done zero work and transferred zero energy.

climax.text: Force is the actor, distance is the stage, and energy is what flows when the performance happens.

punchline.text: No movement, no work—no matter how hard you push.

quiz.question: When is zero work done?
options: When force is applied but nothing moves
